page.overview:
Who is Deep Blue?

Deep Blue is an Autobot who appears in the game Transformers: Online. Candid and forthright, she intimidates many new soldiers with her cold and emotionless demeanor. Those close to her know the truth: Deep Blue acts as such to hide and forget the pain the Great War has caused her. She now fights to bring about a decisive end to the war.
